name: Sheraton Grand Krakow
positioning: A riverside hotel at the foot of Wawel Royal Castle on the banks of the Vistula, on the site of the 18th-century Royal Brewery, with castle and river views, a health club and a rooftop terrace
best_for: City-break travelers who want to walk to the Old Town from a riverside base
Guests who want a room or suite with views of Wawel Castle and the Vistula River
Families with children who enjoy local treats like the Wawel Dragon chocolate egg

facts.text: The riverside setting and walkable location make it easy to explore the Old Town.
In the 19th century the site was transformed into military barracks.
The hotel's contemporary architecture incorporates a historic flood gauge.
Rooms and suites can have views of the river and Wawel Castle.
Rooms and suites have desks and coffee and tea-making facilities.
Premium rooms and suites feature 65-inch TVs, BOSE sound systems and Nespresso machines, with views of Wawel Castle or the Vistula River.
The Grand Deluxe Suite has a separate living area, a dining area and two bathrooms.
The Club Lounge offers snacks, drinks, views and personalized service.
Anima is the hotel's Italian restaurant.
Every child under 13 receives a chocolate egg inspired by Krakow's mythical Wawel Dragon.
Children staying at the hotel get free entry to the Live Bagel Museum, which celebrates the obwarzanek.
The hotel is pet-friendly and welcomes pets for a fee.

highlights.text: The hotel is at the foot of the Royal Castle on the banks of the Vistula River.
The Royal Wawel Suite has panoramic views of Wawel Royal Castle and the Vistula River.
The riverside site was first home to the Royal Brewery in the 18th century.
The Sheraton Health Club includes a gym, pool, sauna, jacuzzi and spa treatments.
The Roof Top Terrace is an open-air rooftop bar with views over the river and castle.

considerations.text: Access to the Sheraton Club is available for an additional charge.
Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel's unremarkable exterior belies the professional and attentive service inside.
WhataHotel notes the large hotel size may feel less intimate than a boutique property.
